newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel group may seek referendum.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel group may seek referendum.

text.p: The board of Adacte, a French shareholder group representing some of Eurotunnel SA/Plc's shareholders, will decide on Tuesday evening whether to call for a referendum of the 600,000 French stockholders on the company's debt restructuring.
"The board will give its view on the principle of a referendum," a member of the Association de defense des actionnaires d'Eurotunnel (Adacte) said.
Shareholders would be called to vote either for or against the debt agreement at the next shareholders meeting, which could be held in late March or early April.
Adacte deputy chairman Jean-Salwa has said the debt pact amounted to a "declaration of war" by the banks on the shareholders.

Adacte wanted a write-off of half the debt and a conversion price of 25 francs ($4.84) per share, neither of which was included in the package of debt measures aimed at lightening Eurotunnel's 69.6 billion francs of debt.
Eurotunnel announced terms of its debt restructuring on Monday, including an initial swap of eight billion francs of loans for new shares at 10.40 francs per share.
